title: Good-Standing Amount Worked from the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement Ledger
content:
The good-standing amount of a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is the agreement's balance due, worked out from the ledger as its rent, fee, reversal and refund entries less its payment, credit and sale-proceeds entries, rounded to the cent.

## Ledger entries and their direction

| Entries that add | Entries that subtract |
|---|---|
| rent charges | payments |
| fee charges of every kind | credits (courtesy waivers, billing-error corrections, move-out credits, applied deposits) |
| payment reversals | applied lien-sale proceeds |
| refunds paid out to the tenant | |

Security deposit entries are not among these, since the deposit is held apart from the balance due.

## Worked figure (hypothetical agreement)

| Entry | Amount |
|---|---|
| rent charges, March and April | $125.00 each |
| late fee, March | $25.00 |
| payment, March | $125.00 |
| courtesy waiver credit on the March late fee | $25.00 |

Adding entries total $275.00; subtracting entries total $150.00; the good-standing amount is $125.00.
